trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The setup matters more than aim: pick a fight with at least five enemies grouped up, trigger Combat Focus once, and drop all five before it expires. Practise the ability's timing on smaller groups first.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies together
Position so all five are reachable in one activation
Trigger Combat Focus once
Take down 5 enemies before it expires

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The official description names a one-time unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Do it while VCIA is open to you during the story (around VCIA Takedown, id 12); a departure you can only make once cannot be retried after the story moves on.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. In plain terms: leave the airport in a way the schedule never intended — take an aircraft outside a story-scripted departure while you have access to the field. This Atlas flags it act-early because the opportunity lives at VCIA during the story, so attempt it around your VCIA story business rather than leaving it for the post-game.
steps: Go to VCIA while it is open to you in the story
Reach an aircraft on the field
Take off outside any scripted departure
The trophy unlocks as you depart
